title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass European Style | Matte Gray | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a freestanding toilet tissue stand that requires no wall mounting and makes roll changes quick and easy in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials.

  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Easy roll changes: European style hook simplifies replacing toilet tissue
  • Steady placement: heavy base helps prevent tipping
  • Solid brass construction: crafted for enduring use

Specs

  • Category: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stands
  • Material: Brass
  • Overall dimensions: 26-Inch H x 6.75-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • Included: Toilet tissue stand
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Assembled in the USA

Designed to complement traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.
